about: What a personal PS Supabase project needs (5 Nov 2026, Connect your own Supabase). PS's setup applies these migrations in order and deploys these functions on a project someone links themselves (ps-mac Sources/ProjectSetup.swift), and applies new ones on update. scripts/ps-kit.mjs packs them into the Mac app (Contents/Resources/project-kit). tests/ps-core.test.ts checks every table and function the app calls exists after them. The developer only feeds (Gmail, calendar, Instantly, Telegram, follow up, cron and pg_net, Claude's drop keys) never go to anyone else's project. A release that changes this list or one of these files must be a release with the app (npm run release -- --app).
